question: L-Dopa is combined with carbidopa in the treatment of parkinsonism to -

options.opc: Increase the dose of levodopa required
options.opd: Inhibit conversion of levodopa to dopamine in the CNS

analysis: L-Dopa (levodopa) is combined with carbidopa to inhibit the conversion of levodopa to dopamine in the peripheral tissues, which allows more levodopa to reach the brain where it can be converted to dopamine. This combination helps to reduce side effects and increase the efficacy of levodopa in treating parkinsonism.
